Informed repository implementation study after c8fdf090 forward-arrow support.
The existing #83 contract selects two exact ports, an Iso ceiling for general
arrows, exact middle-tree composition, ordered tensor and principal-Unitary
two-sided adjoint access. Preparation is Unit -> Bit. No uninformed model,
new constitutional interpretation, QFT implementation or proof is attempted.
The five first sources are retained before the first checks. Desired positive
results are H|0>, |0> tensor the original bit, the explicit Unit/Bit unitor
inverse, and the identity composite; the wrong middle tree must reject.
Native acceptance alone will not prove source preservation.
